infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: FitPulse requires access to your health data to count steps, measure distance, and display daily active minutes directly on your dashboard.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: FitPulse requires write access to log completed workouts and routines back to your health records.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: FitPulse requires motion permission to detect steps and activity changes in the background.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: FitPulse uses location to measure speed for classifying activity states like driving/riding.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: FitPulse uses background location to measure speed for classifying activity states like driving/riding.

plugins.healthSharePermission: FitPulse wants to read step data to track progress.
